      • withEdgeLabel

        @NonNull
NextT withEdgeLabel(@Nullable
                             CqlIdentifier edgeLabelId,
                             @NonNull
                             DseGraphEdgeSide from,
                             @NonNull
                             DseGraphEdgeSide to)
        Adds an edge label to this table.

        Use DseGraphEdgeSide.table(CqlIdentifier) to build the definitions of both sides, for example: 

        
 withEdgeLabel("contrib",
               table("person")
                 .withPartitionKey("contributor"),
               table("soft")
                 .withPartitionKey("company_name"),
                 .withPartitionKey("software_name"),
                 .withClusteringColumn("software_version"))
